The class quests

Warriors have a few important class quests. The most important ones unlock Defensive Stance and Berserker Stance, and give you your Whirlwind weapon.

Level Reward Alliance Horde
10 Defensive Stance, Taunt, Sunder Armor Human: Bartleby’s Mug. Dwarf and Gnome: Vejrek. Night Elf: Vorlus Vilehoof. High Order Skyborne: The Skybreaker Bulwark Orc, Troll and Tauren: Path of Defense. Undead: Ulag the Cleaver
20 Armor Fire Hardened Hauberk, from the chain that starts with Fire Hardened Mail Brutal Hauberk, from Brutal Hauberk
30 Berserker Stance, Intercept The Affray The Affray
30 Whirlwind Axe, Whirlwind Sword or Whirlwind Warhammer Whirlwind Weapon Whirlwind Weapon
